name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.ui.view.main.view.QuestionnaireCounselActivity
description: During a counseling flow in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen loads counseling intake questions and consent information. It collects the answers and required privacy choices for submission to the service.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the counseling intake questions or record the related consent choices here.
